description_en: Creates a configuration for modifying HTTP inbound response headers for a site
description_zh: 新增站点的修改HTTP入站响应头配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-http-incoming-response-header-modification-rule --site-id 608665779308176 --response-header-modification Type=static Value=headerValue Operation=add Name=headerName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

fields.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

add: adds a response header.
del: deletes a response header.
modify: modifies a response header
fields.help_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更
fields.name: operation

fields.help_en:
The value type. Valid values:
static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic pattern
fields.help_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The response header modifications. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify
parameters.help_zh: 修改响应头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式
parameters.name: response_header_modification

parameters.help_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
